First release of Zenith Trade, a price-check overlay for Path of Exile 1 on Windows.

## Install

Download `Zenith-win-Setup.exe` below and run it. It installs for your user only (no admin rights), adds a Start menu entry and starts Zenith Trade in the system tray. Later versions install themselves on restart.

Windows SmartScreen may warn that the publisher is unknown, because the installer is not signed: click "More info", then "Run anyway".

## Keys

- `Ctrl+D`: price check the item under the cursor
- `Shift+Space`: quick menu (stash searches, map filter, settings)
- `F7`: map mods
- `Alt+W`: wiki page of the item
- `Ctrl+Shift+Q`: quit

Every key can be changed in the settings (right-click the tray icon).

## What's in it

- Price check for gear, jewels, gems, maps, uniques, flasks and stackables: the panel opens with the item read and an estimate, then the listings arrive
- Mod filters with tier, min and max, roll slider, pseudo totals, exclude, "any N of these", pure tier, item level, quality, links, corrupted, influences, Foulborn, fractured base
- Weapon DPS, physical and elemental DPS, crit and attack speed
- Currency and stackables priced from poe.ninja, with the 7-day trend and live bulk offers
- Map mods tagged good, warning or danger
- Saved stash searches, chat command keys, `Ctrl+wheel` over the inventory to change stash tab
- Six themes, choices that stick between checks
